concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-finland-online-banking-flutter-drop-in]] — 2026-09-15-captured Finland online banking Flutter Drop-in Sessions/Advanced add-on for email, conditional issuer, redirect handling and Paytrail testing; source flags setup and sample limitations.
warnings: Sessions setup says contact Adyen Support, whereas Advanced says add the method in Customer Area; do not flatten these into one asserted setup path.

Advanced table requires paymentMethod.type but all TEST request examples omit paymentMethod; sample email is malformed, Advanced returnUrl is HTTPS in a Flutter guide, and both curl commands lack continuation after -X POST.
Guide says multiple partial refunds cannot currently be tested while the separate method overview marks that capability available and points to a missing refund note.
